title: Mind For Music
text: An analysis of how musical genres have evolved across the Billboard Hot 100, comparing all-time chart toppers against every year from 1958 to 2024. You can inspect the complete song-level data on the Explore the data page.

title: Mind For Music
section: How Technology Eras Transformed Music Genres (1958 – 2024)
text:
How Technology Eras Transformed Music Genres (1958 – 2024)
How did the transition from vinyl and transistor radios to MP3s, streaming, and social media alter what reached the top of the Billboard charts? Below, each technology era displays the market share of major genres side-by-side. Hover over any bar to compare how genres rose or declined as technology evolved.

Every Single Hit Song (1958 – 2024)
An interactive chart displaying all 6,700 songs to reach the annual Billboard Top 100. Hover over any point to explore the song title, artist, rank, weeks on chart, and genre.

section: Song Staying Power vs. Chart Peak: Interactive Bubble View

Song Staying Power vs. Chart Peak: Interactive Bubble View
How do a song’s peak ranking and chart longevity relate to overall success? In the bubble chart below, every point is a Billboard Hot 100 hit. The bubble size represents total chart points earned, and the color indicates genre. Click any song to lock its details in the card below.
